name: QuadraticTangZhang.normSq_sub_coordinates
type:
∀ (q : ℂ) (x y : ℝ),
  Complex.normSq (q - { re := x, im := y }) = Complex.normSq q - 2 * x * q.re - 2 * y * q.im + (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.sum_normSq_sub
type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (q : Fin m → ℂ) (x y : ℝ),
  ∑ i, Complex.normSq (q i - { re := x, im := y }) =
    ∑ i, Complex.normSq (q i) - 2 * x * ∑ i, (q i).re - 2 * y * ∑ i, (q i).im + ↑m * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.variance_identity
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ),
      (∑ i, Complex.normSq (q i - { re := QuadraticTangZhang.meanRe q, im := QuadraticTangZhang.meanIm q })) / ↑m =
        QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q - (QuadraticTangZhang.meanRe q ^ 2 + QuadraticTangZhang.meanIm q ^ 2)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.mean_sq_le_secondMoment
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ),
      QuadraticTangZhang.meanRe q ^ 2 + QuadraticTangZhang.meanIm q ^ 2 ≤ QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q

name: QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment_nonneg
type: ∀ {m : ℕ} (q : Fin m → ℂ), 0 ≤ QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q

name: QuadraticTangZhang.meanRe_bounds
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ),
      QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q ≤ 1 → -1 ≤ QuadraticTangZhang.meanRe q ∧ QuadraticTangZhang.meanRe q ≤ 1

name: QuadraticTangZhang.sum_centered_re
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ), ∑ i, ((q i).re - QuadraticTangZhang.meanRe q) = 0

name: QuadraticTangZhang.sum_centered_im
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ), ∑ i, ((q i).im - QuadraticTangZhang.meanIm q) = 0

name: QuadraticTangZhang.boundary_secondMoment
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ), ↑m ≤ ∑ i, (q i).re → 1 ≤ QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q

name: QuadraticTangZhang.boundary_rigidity
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ), ↑m ≤ ∑ i, (q i).re → QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q = 1 → ∀ (i : Fin m), q i = 1

name: QuadraticTangZhang.boundary_equality_iff
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ), ↑m ≤ ∑ i, (q i).re → (QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q = 1 ↔ ∀ (i : Fin m), q i = 1)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.affine_normSq
type: ∀ (q : ℂ) (a b : ℝ), Complex.normSq (↑a + ↑b * q) = a ^ 2 + 2 * a * b * q.re + b ^ 2 * Complex.normSq q

name: QuadraticTangZhang.affine_secondMoment
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ) (a b : ℝ),
      (QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment fun i => ↑a + ↑b * q i) =
        a ^ 2 + 2 * a * b * QuadraticTangZhang.meanRe q + b ^ 2 * QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q

name: QuadraticTangZhang.criticalReciprocals_card
type: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℂ) (a : ℂ), (QuadraticTangZhang.criticalReciprocals p a).card = p.natDegree - 1

name: QuadraticTangZhang.criticalReciprocals_ne_zero
type:
∀ (p : Polynomial ℂ) (a : ℂ),
  Polynomial.eval a (Polynomial.derivative p) ≠ 0 → ∀ v ∈ QuadraticTangZhang.criticalReciprocals p a, v ≠ 0

name: QuadraticTangZhang.criticalReciprocals_factorization
type:
∀ (p : Polynomial ℂ) (a : ℂ),
  Polynomial.derivative p =
    Polynomial.C (↑p.natDegree * p.leadingCoeff) *
      (Multiset.map (fun z => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C z)
          (Multiset.map (fun v => a - v⁻¹) (QuadraticTangZhang.criticalReciprocals p a))).prod

name: QuadraticTangZhang.reciprocalEnergy_of_ne
type: ∀ {a z : ℂ}, a ≠ z → QuadraticTangZhang.reciprocalEnergy a z = ENNReal.ofReal (Complex.normSq (a - z)⁻¹)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.ofReal_multiset_sum
type: ∀ {S : Multiset ℝ}, (∀ x ∈ S, 0 ≤ x) → ENNReal.ofReal S.sum = (Multiset.map ENNReal.ofReal S).sum

name: QuadraticTangZhang.criticalEnergy_eq_ofReal
type:
∀ (p : Polynomial ℂ) (a : ℂ),
  Polynomial.eval a (Polynomial.derivative p) ≠ 0 →
    QuadraticTangZhang.criticalEnergy p a =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Multiset.map (⇑Complex.normSq) (QuadraticTangZhang.criticalReciprocals p a)).sum

name: QuadraticTangZhang.reciprocal_sum_le_of_energy_le
type:
∀ (p : Polynomial ℂ) (a : ℂ),
  Polynomial.eval a (Polynomial.derivative p) ≠ 0 →
    QuadraticTangZhang.criticalEnergy p a ≤ ↑(p.natDegree - 1) →
      (Multiset.map (fun v => ‖v‖ ^ 2) (QuadraticTangZhang.criticalReciprocals p a)).sum ≤ ↑(p.natDegree - 1)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.multiset_variance_real
type:
∀ (q : Multiset ℂ) (x : ℝ),
  (Multiset.map (fun v => Complex.normSq (v - ↑x)) q).sum =
    (Multiset.map (fun v => ‖v‖ ^ 2) q).sum - 2 * x * (Multiset.map Complex.re q).sum + ↑q.card * x ^ 2

name: QuadraticTangZhang.multiset_mean_sq_le
type:
∀ {q : Multiset ℂ},
  0 < q.card →
    ∀ {x s : ℝ},
      (Multiset.map Complex.re q).sum = ↑q.card * x → (Multiset.map (fun v => ‖v‖ ^ 2) q).sum = ↑q.card * s → x ^ 2 ≤ s

name: QuadraticTangZhang.reciprocalEnergy_self
type: ∀ (a : ℂ), QuadraticTangZhang.reciprocalEnergy a a = ⊤

name: QuadraticTangZhang.reciprocalEnergy_eq_top_iff
type: ∀ (a z : ℂ), QuadraticTangZhang.reciprocalEnergy a z = ⊤ ↔ a = z

name: QuadraticTangZhang.criticalEnergy_eq_top_of_mem
type: ∀ {p : Polynomial ℂ} {a : ℂ}, a ∈ (Polynomial.derivative p).roots → QuadraticTangZhang.criticalEnergy p a = ⊤

name: QuadraticTangZhang.main_at_common_zero
type:
∀ {p : Polynomial ℂ} {a : ℂ},
  a ∈ (Polynomial.derivative p).roots → ↑(p.natDegree - 1) < QuadraticTangZhang.criticalEnergy p a

name: Sendov.prod_cons_eq
type:
∀ (a : ℂ) (z : Multiset ℂ),
  (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) * (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w) z).prod =
    (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w) (a ::ₘ z)).prod

name: Sendov.centroid_identity
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {a c : ℂ} {z q : Multiset ℂ},
  2 ≤ n →
    ∀ {p : Polynomial ℂ},
      c ≠ 0 →
        z.card = n - 1 →
          q.card = n - 1 →
            p =
                Polynomial.C c *
                  ((Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) * (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w) z).prod) →
              Polynomial.derivative p =
                  Polynomial.C (↑n * c) *
                    (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w) (Multiset.map (fun v => a - v⁻¹) q)).prod →
                (↑n - 1) * (a + z.sum) = ↑n * (Multiset.map (fun v => a - v⁻¹) q).sum

name: Sendov.sumEraseProd_zero
type: Sendov.sumEraseProd 0 = 0

name: Sendov.sumEraseProd_cons
type: ∀ (v : ℂ) (t : Multiset ℂ), Sendov.sumEraseProd (v ::ₘ t) = t.prod + v * Sendov.sumEraseProd t

name: Sendov.prod_map_neg
type: ∀ (s : Multiset ℂ), (Multiset.map (fun w => -w) s).prod = (-1) ^ s.card * s.prod

name: Sendov.eval_prod_zero
type:
∀ (z : Multiset ℂ),
  Polynomial.eval 0 (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w) z).prod = (-1) ^ z.card * z.prod

name: Sendov.eval_deriv_prod_zero
type:
∀ (z : Multiset ℂ),
  Polynomial.eval 0 (Polynomial.derivative (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w) z).prod) =
    -((-1) ^ z.card * Sendov.sumEraseProd z)

name: Sendov.prod_inv_sub_mul
type:
∀ {a : ℂ} (q : Multiset ℂ),
  (∀ v ∈ q, v ≠ 0) → (Multiset.map (fun v => v⁻¹ - a) q).prod * q.prod = (Multiset.map (fun v => 1 - a * v) q).prod

name: Sendov.second_origin_identity
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {a c : ℂ} {z q : Multiset ℂ} {p : Polynomial ℂ},
  c ≠ 0 →
    z.card = n - 1 →
      (∀ v ∈ q, v ≠ 0) →
        p =
            Polynomial.C c *
              ((Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) * (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w) z).prod) →
          Polynomial.derivative p =
              Polynomial.C (↑n * c) *
                (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w) (Multiset.map (fun v => a - v⁻¹) q)).prod →
            ↑n * (Multiset.map (fun v => 1 - a * v) q).prod =
              (-1) ^ (n - 1) * q.prod * (z.prod + a * Sendov.sumEraseProd z)

name: Sendov.continuous_deriv_seg
type: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℂ) (a w : ℂ), Continuous fun t => Polynomial.eval (a + ↑t * (w - a)) (Polynomial.derivative p)

name: Sendov.eval_eq_integral
type:
∀ {p : Polynomial ℂ} {a : ℂ},
  Polynomial.eval a p = 0 →
    ∀ (w : ℂ),
      Polynomial.eval w p = (w - a) * ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, Polynomial.eval (a + ↑t * (w - a)) (Polynomial.derivative p)

name: Sendov.first_origin_identity
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {a c : ℂ} {z q : Multiset ℂ} {p : Polynomial ℂ},
  c ≠ 0 →
    a ≠ 0 →
      z.card = n - 1 →
        (∀ v ∈ q, v ≠ 0) →
          Polynomial.eval a p = 0 →
            p =
                Polynomial.C c *
                  ((Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) * (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w) z).prod) →
              Polynomial.derivative p =
                  Polynomial.C (↑n * c) *
                    (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w) (Multiset.map (fun v => a - v⁻¹) q)).prod →
                ↑n * ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, (Multiset.map (fun v => 1 - a * ↑t * v) q).prod =
                  (-1) ^ (n - 1) * q.prod * z.prod

name: Sendov.prod_map_mul_const
type: ∀ (b : ℂ) (s : Multiset ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ), (Multiset.map (fun v => b * f v) s).prod = b ^ s.card * (Multiset.map f s).prod

name: Sendov.prod_inv_mul
type: ∀ (q : Multiset ℂ), (∀ v ∈ q, v ≠ 0) → (Multiset.map (fun v => v⁻¹) q).prod * q.prod = 1

name: Sendov.prod_sub_mul_prod
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {a c : ℂ} {z q : Multiset ℂ} {p : Polynomial ℂ},
  c ≠ 0 →
    (∀ v ∈ q, v ≠ 0) →
      p =
          Polynomial.C c *
            ((Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) * (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w) z).prod) →
        Polynomial.derivative p =
            Polynomial.C (↑n * c) *
              (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w) (Multiset.map (fun v => a - v⁻¹) q)).prod →
          q.prod * (Multiset.map (fun w => a - w) z).prod = ↑n

name: Sendov.polar_identity
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {a c : ℂ} {z q : Multiset ℂ} {p : Polynomial ℂ},
  c ≠ 0 →
    a ≠ 0 →
      a ^ 2 ≠ 1 →
        z.card = n - 1 →
          q.card = n - 1 →
            (∀ v ∈ q, v ≠ 0) →
              Polynomial.eval a p = 0 →
                p =
                    Polynomial.C c *
                      ((Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) *
                        (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w) z).prod) →
                  Polynomial.derivative p =
                      Polynomial.C (↑n * c) *
                        (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w)
                            (Multiset.map (fun v => a - v⁻¹) q)).prod →
                    q.prod * (Multiset.map (fun w => 1 - a * w) z).prod =
                      ↑n * ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, (Multiset.map (fun v => a + ↑t * (1 - a ^ 2) * v) q).prod

name: Sendov.exists_root_multiset
type:
∀ {n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ {p : Polynomial ℂ},
      p.natDegree = n →
        (∀ w ∈ p.roots, ‖w‖ ≤ 1) →
          ∀ {a : ℂ},
            Polynomial.eval a p = 0 →
              ∃ z,
                z.card = n - 1 ∧
                  (∀ w ∈ z, ‖w‖ ≤ 1) ∧
                    p =
                      Polynomial.C p.leadingCoeff *
                        ((Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) *
                          (Multiset.map (fun w => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C w) z).prod)

name: Sendov.exists_crit_multiset
type:
∀ {n : ℕ},
  2 ≤ n →
    ∀ {p : Polynomial ℂ},
      p.natDegree = n →
        ∀ {a : ℂ},
          (∀ (w : ℂ), Polynomial.eval w (Polynomial.derivative p) = 0 → 1 ≤ ‖w - a‖) →
            ∃ q,
              q.card = n - 1 ∧
                (∀ v ∈ q, ‖v‖ ≤ 1) ∧
                  (∀ v ∈ q, v ≠ 0) ∧
                    Polynomial.derivative p =
                      Polynomial.C (↑n * p.leadingCoeff) *
                        (Multiset.map (fun v => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (a - v⁻¹)) q).prod

name: QuadraticTangZhang.weighted_product_split
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (D c : Polynomial ℂ) (w : ι → Polynomial ℂ),
  D * ∑ j ∈ s, w j * ∏ k ∈ s.erase j, (D - c * w k) =
    (∑ j ∈ s, w j) * ∏ k ∈ s, (D - c * w k) + c * ∑ j ∈ s, w j ^ 2 * ∏ k ∈ s.erase j, (D - c * w k)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.centered_interpolation_polynomial
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (D c : ℂ) (w : ι → ℂ),
  ∑ j ∈ s, w j = 0 →
    Polynomial.C D *
        Polynomial.derivative (∏ j ∈ s, (Polynomial.C D - Polynomial.C c * Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (w j))) =
      -Polynomial.C (c ^ 2) * Polynomial.X *
        ∑ j ∈ s,
          Polynomial.C (w j ^ 2) *
            ∏ k ∈ s.erase j, (Polynomial.C D - Polynomial.C c * Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (w k))

name: QuadraticTangZhang.origin_derivative_polynomial
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (a : ℂ) (q : ι → ℂ),
  Polynomial.derivative (∏ j ∈ s, (1 - Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (q j))) =
    -Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.C (∑ j ∈ s, q j) * ∏ k ∈ s, (1 - Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (q k)) -
      Polynomial.C (a ^ 2) * Polynomial.X *
        ∑ j ∈ s, Polynomial.C (q j ^ 2) * ∏ k ∈ s.erase j, (1 - Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (q k))

name: QuadraticTangZhang.norm_meanComplex_sq
type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (q : Fin m → ℂ),
  ‖QuadraticTangZhang.meanComplex q‖ ^ 2 = QuadraticTangZhang.meanRe q ^ 2 + QuadraticTangZhang.meanIm q ^ 2

name: QuadraticTangZhang.sum_sub_meanComplex
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ), ∑ j, (q j - QuadraticTangZhang.meanComplex q) = 0

name: QuadraticTangZhang.centered_variance_sum
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ),
      ∑ j, ‖q j - QuadraticTangZhang.meanComplex q‖ ^ 2 =
        ↑m * (QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q - ‖QuadraticTangZhang.meanComplex q‖ ^ 2)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.norm_meanComplex_le_one
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ), QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q ≤ 1 → ‖QuadraticTangZhang.meanComplex q‖ ≤ 1

name: QuadraticTangZhang.one_sub_meanComplex_ne_zero
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ),
      QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q ≤ 1 → ∀ {u : ℝ}, 0 ≤ u → u < 1 → 1 - ↑u * QuadraticTangZhang.meanComplex q ≠ 0

name: QuadraticTangZhang.sum_origin_norm_sq
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ) (a t : ℝ),
      ∑ j, ‖1 - ↑a * ↑t * q j‖ ^ 2 =
        ↑m * QuadraticTangZhang.betaS a (QuadraticTangZhang.meanRe q) (QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q) t

name: QuadraticTangZhang.centered_remainder_estimate
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    ∀ (q : Fin m → ℂ),
      QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q ≤ 1 →
        ∀ {a t : ℝ},
          0 ≤ a →
            a < 1 →
              0 ≤ t →
                t ≤ 1 →
                  ‖∏ j, (1 - ↑a * ↑t * q j) - (1 - ↑a * ↑t * QuadraticTangZhang.meanComplex q) ^ m‖ ≤
                    5 * ↑m * a ^ 2 * t ^ 2 *
                          (QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q - ‖QuadraticTangZhang.meanComplex q‖ ^ 2) /
                        (6 * ‖1 - ↑a * ↑t * QuadraticTangZhang.meanComplex q‖) *
                      QuadraticTangZhang.betaS a (QuadraticTangZhang.meanRe q) (QuadraticTangZhang.secondMoment q) t ^
                        (↑(m - 1) / 2)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.prod_norm_sq_le_mean
type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ), ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ^ 2) / ↑s.card) ^ s.card

name: QuadraticTangZhang.norm_prod_le_moment
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι),
  0 < s.card → ∀ (f : ι → ℂ) {B : ℝ}, 0 ≤ B → ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ^ 2 ≤ ↑s.card * B → ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ B ^ (↑s.card / 2)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.norm_deleted_prod_le
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι),
  2 ≤ s.card →
    ∀ j ∈ s,
      ∀ (f : ι → ℂ) {B : ℝ},
        0 ≤ B → ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ^ 2 ≤ ↑s.card * B → ‖∏ i ∈ s.erase j, f i‖ ≤ 5 / 3 * B ^ (↑(s.card - 1) / 2)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.exp_one_bounds
type: 27 / 10 < Real.exp 1 ∧ Real.exp 1 < 11 / 4

name: QuadraticTangZhang.sqrt_exp_one_lt
type: √(Real.exp 1) < 5 / 3

name: QuadraticTangZhang.log_three_eighths_million
type: 12 < Real.log 375000

name: QuadraticTangZhang.log_fifty_thousand
type: 4 < Real.log 50000

name: Sendov.Multiset.prod_le_mean_pow
type: ∀ (s : Multiset ℝ), (∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ x) → s.prod ≤ (s.sum / ↑s.card) ^ s.card

name: Sendov.esymm_card_cons
type: ∀ (a : ℝ) (t : Multiset ℝ), t ≠ 0 → (a ::ₘ t).esymm t.card = t.prod + a * t.esymm (t.card - 1)

name: Sendov.Multiset.esymm_card_pred_le
type: ∀ (s : Multiset ℝ), (∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ x) → s ≠ 0 → s.esymm (s.card - 1) ≤ ↑s.card * (s.sum / ↑s.card) ^ (s.card - 1)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.beta_decomposition
type: ∀ (a x t : ℝ), QuadraticTangZhang.beta a x t = 1 - x ^ 2 + (x - a * t) ^ 2

name: QuadraticTangZhang.betaS_le_beta
type: ∀ (a x s t : ℝ), s ≤ 1 → QuadraticTangZhang.betaS a x s t ≤ QuadraticTangZhang.beta a x t

name: QuadraticTangZhang.beta_one_pos
type: ∀ {a x : ℝ}, 0 < a → a < 1 → -1 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → 0 < QuadraticTangZhang.beta a x 1

name: QuadraticTangZhang.x_gt_half_of_beta_lt_one
type: ∀ {a x : ℝ}, 0 < a → QuadraticTangZhang.beta a x 1 < 1 → a / 2 < x

name: QuadraticTangZhang.rho_identity
type: ∀ (a x s : ℝ), QuadraticTangZhang.rho a x s = 1 - QuadraticTangZhang.beta a x 1 - (1 - a ^ 2) * (1 - s)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.rho_le_gap
type: ∀ {a x s : ℝ}, a ^ 2 ≤ 1 → s ≤ 1 → QuadraticTangZhang.rho a x s ≤ 1 - QuadraticTangZhang.beta a x 1

name: QuadraticTangZhang.rho_le_sq
type: ∀ {a x s : ℝ}, a ^ 2 ≤ 1 → s ≤ 1 → QuadraticTangZhang.rho a x s ≤ x ^ 2

name: QuadraticTangZhang.betaS_endpoint
type: ∀ (a x s : ℝ), QuadraticTangZhang.betaS a x s 1 = s - QuadraticTangZhang.rho a x s

name: QuadraticTangZhang.betaS_endpoint_le
type: ∀ {a x s : ℝ}, s ≤ 1 → QuadraticTangZhang.betaS a x s 1 ≤ 1 - QuadraticTangZhang.rho a x s

name: QuadraticTangZhang.polar_chord_gap
type:
∀ (a x s t : ℝ),
  a ^ 2 + (1 - a ^ 2) * (1 + QuadraticTangZhang.rho a x s) * t - QuadraticTangZhang.polarQuadratic a x s t =
    (1 - a ^ 2) ^ 2 * s * t * (1 - t)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.polar_le_chord
type:
∀ {a x s t : ℝ},
  0 ≤ s →

                1 ≤ ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, QuadraticTangZhang.polarQuadratic a x s t ^ (↑m / 2) →
                  have α := ↑m / 2 * (1 - a ^ 2);
                  Real.log α / α < 1 - QuadraticTangZhang.beta a x 1

name: QuadraticTangZhang.prod_norm_le_exact_moment
type:
∀ {q : Multiset ℂ},
  0 < q.card →
    ∀ {a x s t : ℝ},
      (Multiset.map Complex.re q).sum = ↑q.card * x →
        (Multiset.map (fun v => ‖v‖ ^ 2) q).sum = ↑q.card * s →
          (Multiset.map (fun v => ‖↑a + ↑t * (1 - ↑a ^ 2) * v‖) q).prod ≤
            QuadraticTangZhang.polarQuadratic a x s t ^ (↑q.card / 2)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.exact_polar_inequality
type:
∀ {q : Multiset ℂ},

      (Multiset.map Complex.re q).sum = ↑q.card * x →
        (Multiset.map (fun v => ‖v‖ ^ 2) q).sum = ↑q.card * s →
          1 ≤ ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, (Multiset.map (fun v => ‖↑a + ↑t * (1 - ↑a ^ 2) * v‖) q).prod →
            1 ≤ ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, QuadraticTangZhang.polarQuadratic a x s t ^ (↑q.card / 2)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.polarQuadratic_nonneg
type: ∀ {a x s t : ℝ}, x ^ 2 ≤ s → 0 ≤ QuadraticTangZhang.polarQuadratic a x s t

name: QuadraticTangZhang.polarQuadratic_le_square
type:
∀ {a x s t : ℝ},
  0 ≤ a → a ≤ 1 → x ≤ 1 → s ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ t → QuadraticTangZhang.polarQuadratic a x s t ≤ (a + (1 - a ^ 2) * t) ^ 2

name: QuadraticTangZhang.small_degree_polar_contradiction
type:
∀ {a x s : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    a < 1 →
      x ≤ 1 →
        x ^ 2 ≤ s →
          s ≤ 1 →
            ∀ {m : ℕ},
              1 ≤ m → m ≤ 4 → 1 ≤ ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, QuadraticTangZhang.polarQuadratic a x s t ^ (↑m / 2) → False

name: Sendov.norm_multiset_prod
type: ∀ (s : Multiset ℂ), ‖s.prod‖ = (Multiset.map (fun w => ‖w‖) s).prod

name: Sendov.prod_map_le_of_le
type:
∀ {s : Multiset ℂ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
  (∀ w ∈ s, ‖f w‖ ≤ ‖g w‖) → (Multiset.map (fun w => ‖f w‖) s).prod ≤ (Multiset.map (fun w => ‖g w‖) s).prod

name: Sendov.norm_prod_map
type: ∀ (s : Multiset ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ), ‖(Multiset.map f s).prod‖ = (Multiset.map (fun w => ‖f w‖) s).prod

name: Sendov.prod_map_norm_nonneg
type: ∀ (s : Multiset ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ), 0 ≤ (Multiset.map (fun w => ‖f w‖) s).prod

name: Sendov.one_le_integral_prod_norm
type:
∀ {n : ℕ},
  2 ≤ n →
    ∀ {a : ℝ},
      |a| ≤ 1 →
        ∀ {z q : Multiset ℂ},
          (∀ w ∈ z, ‖w‖ ≤ 1) →
            q.prod * (Multiset.map (fun w => 1 - ↑a * w) z).prod =
                ↑n * ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, (Multiset.map (fun v => ↑a + ↑t * (1 - ↑a ^ 2) * v) q).prod →
              q.prod * (Multiset.map (fun w => ↑a - w) z).prod = ↑n →
                1 ≤ ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, (Multiset.map (fun v => ‖↑a + ↑t * (1 - ↑a ^ 2) * v‖) q).prod

name: Sendov.prod_map_sq
type: ∀ (s : Multiset ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℝ), (Multiset.map (fun v => f v ^ 2) s).prod = (Multiset.map f s).prod ^ 2

name: Sendov.sum_norm_sq_split
type:
∀ (a s : ℝ) (q : Multiset ℂ),
  (Multiset.map (fun v => ‖↑a + ↑s * v‖ ^ 2) q).sum =
    ↑q.card * a ^ 2 + 2 * a * s * (Multiset.map (fun v => v.re) q).sum + s ^ 2 * (Multiset.map (fun v => ‖v‖ ^ 2) q).sum

name: Sendov.sum_norm_sq_le_card
type: ∀ (q : Multiset ℂ), (∀ v ∈ q, ‖v‖ ≤ 1) → (Multiset.map (fun v => ‖v‖ ^ 2) q).sum ≤ ↑q.card

name: Sendov.continuous_prod_norm
type: ∀ (a : ℝ) (q : Multiset ℂ), Continuous fun t => (Multiset.map (fun v => ‖↑a + ↑t * (1 - ↑a ^ 2) * v‖) q).prod

name: QuadraticTangZhang.smallIntegral_mul
type:
∀ (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ),
  (1 - a ^ 2) * QuadraticTangZhang.smallIntegral a k = ((a + (1 - a ^ 2)) ^ (k + 1) - a ^ (k + 1)) / (↑k + 1)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.smallIntegral_one
type: ∀ (a : ℝ), a ^ 2 ≠ 1 → 1 - QuadraticTangZhang.smallIntegral a 1 = (1 - a) ^ 2 / 2

name: QuadraticTangZhang.smallIntegral_two
type: ∀ (a : ℝ), a ^ 2 ≠ 1 → 1 - QuadraticTangZhang.smallIntegral a 2 = (2 - a) * (1 - a) ^ 2 * (a + 1) / 3

name: QuadraticTangZhang.smallIntegral_three
type:
∀ (a : ℝ),
  a ^ 2 ≠ 1 → 1 - QuadraticTangZhang.smallIntegral a 3 = (1 - a) ^ 2 * (a ^ 4 - 2 * a ^ 3 - 2 * a ^ 2 + 2 * a + 3) / 4

name: QuadraticTangZhang.smallIntegral_four
type:
∀ (a : ℝ),
  a ^ 2 ≠ 1 → 1 - QuadraticTangZhang.smallIntegral a 4 = (1 - a) ^ 3 * (1 + a) / 5 * (a ^ 4 - 3 * a ^ 3 + 3 * a + 4)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.smallIntegral_lt_one
type: ∀ {a : ℝ}, 0 < a → a < 1 → ∀ {k : ℕ}, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 4 → QuadraticTangZhang.smallIntegral a k < 1

name: Sendov.integral_exp_mul
type: ∀ {c : ℝ}, c ≠ 0 → ∀ (a b : ℝ), ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, Real.exp (c * t) = (Real.exp (c * b) - Real.exp (c * a)) / c

name: Sendov.sinh_sq_le
type: ∀ {h : ℝ}, 0 ≤ h → (h ^ 2 + 9) * (h * Real.cosh h - Real.sinh h) ^ 2 ≤ h ^ 4 * Real.sinh h ^ 2

name: Sendov.sqrt_mul_sub_le
type: ∀ {h : ℝ}, 0 ≤ h → √(h ^ 2 + 9) * (h * Real.cosh h - Real.sinh h) ≤ h ^ 2 * Real.sinh h

name: Sendov.log_sinh_div_le
type: ∀ {h : ℝ}, 0 < h → Real.log (Real.sinh h / h) ≤ √(h ^ 2 + 9) - 3

name: Sendov.sinh_le_mul_exp
type: ∀ {h : ℝ}, 0 ≤ h → Real.sinh h ≤ h * Real.exp (√(h ^ 2 + 9) - 3)

name: QuadraticTangZhang.rho_pos_of_polar
type:
∀ {a x s : ℝ},
  0 ≤ a →
    a < 1 →
      x ^ 2 ≤ s →
        ∀ {m : ℕ},
          0 < m →
            1 ≤ ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, QuadraticTangZhang.polarQuadratic a x s t ^ (↑m / 2) →
              0 < QuadraticTangZhang.rho a x s

name: QuadraticTangZhang.chord_polar_bound
type:
∀ {a x s : ℝ},
  0 ≤ a →
    a < 1 →
      x ^ 2 ≤ s →
        ∀ {m : ℕ},
          0 < m →
            1 ≤ ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, QuadraticTangZhang.polarQuadratic a x s t ^ (↑m / 2) →
              (1 + (1 - a ^ 2) * QuadraticTangZhang.rho a x s) ^ (↑m / 2 + 1) - a ^ (m + 2) -
                  (↑m / 2 + 1) * (1 - a ^ 2) * (1 + QuadraticTangZhang.rho a x s) ≥

name: QuadraticTangZhang.rho_log_lower_bound
type:
∀ {a x s : ℝ},
  0 ≤ a →
    a < 1 →
      x ^ 2 ≤ s →
        ∀ {m : ℕ},
          0 < m →
            1 ≤ ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, QuadraticTangZhang.polarQuadratic a x s t ^ (↑m / 2) →
              1 < (↑m / 2 + 1) * (1 - a ^ 2) →
                Real.log ((↑m / 2 + 1) * (1 - a ^ 2)) / ((↑m / 2 + 1) * (1 - a ^ 2)) ≤ QuadraticTangZhang.rho a x s
